API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APICloud ApplicationsCloud Applications Resource Get SSL Policy Web Applications
Cloud Applications Resource Get SSL Policy Web Applications
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/cloudApplications/sslPolicy

Retrieves a list of Predefined and User Defined Cloud Applications associated with the SSL Inspection rules.

Retrieves AppInfo when groupResults is set to false and retrieves the application count grouped by application category when groupResults is set to true.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
search
string

Filter application by name

pageSize
int32

Set the size of response

Default value: 200
page
int32

Set the page number of response

Default value: 1
appClass
string[]

Possible values: [WEB_MAIL, SOCIAL_NETWORKING, STREAMING, P2P, INSTANT_MESSAGING, WEB_SEARCH, GENERAL_BROWSING, ADMINISTRATION, ENTERPRISE_COLLABORATION, BUSINESS_PRODUCTIVITY, SALES_AND_MARKETING, SYSTEM_AND_DEVELOPMENT, CONSUMER, FILE_SHARE, HOSTING_PROVIDER, IT_SERVICES, DNS_OVER_HTTPS, HUMAN_RESOURCES, LEGAL, HEALTH_CARE, FINANCE, CUSTOM_CAPP, AI_ML]

Filter application by application category

groupResults
boolean

Show count of applications grouped by application category

Default value: false
Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
app
string

Application enum constant

appName
string

Cloud application name

parent
string

Application category enum constant

parentName
string

Name of the cloud application category
